column1: # Per-bundle ceilings on slot identity violations (closure model K4.3), checked by
# tests/slot_identity.rs against HBC_CORPUS_BUNDLE. Columns: SHA-256 of the bundle,
# label, I1, I2, I3. Lower a ceiling whenever the real count drops.
# The inline_expressions fix gave readers real locals where they had dangling temps;
# the new I1 rows are a parent keeping an unused `let closure_0 = param` alias while
# its child reads the parameter, and the I2 rows are 11 former I3 undeclared captures
# a body now declares.
# declaration binds a function's name in the enclosing body; the checker counted every named
# function the body creates, so Babel's self-replacing helpers (named expressions assigned to the
# module's variable or to a local of another name) read as a local beside the capture. The I1
# rise of S3.4 stays: the merged stamps let the checker see slots that a local was named after
# under a second name (`obj` +319, `first` +120 on equinox), which it could not before.
# -> 361, I3 7 -> 6. A store into a slot of a value named after it (`x = x`) was dropped and
# the slot never written; the drop now stamps the value as the slot. Babel's self-replacing
# helpers assign their slot again (`_getRequireWildcardCache = function
# _getRequireWildcardCache(...)`, where an inner declaration of that name shadowed it), and
# the checker counts the function expression's own name as a local beside the capture
# (1,466 of the new I2 rows are `_getRequireWildcardCache`, 274 `_isNativeReflectConstruct`).
# Undeclared on equinox 6,169 -> 6,159.
# D3.1, slot naming (2026-10-25): I1 equinox 1055 -> 875, coachrx 1103 -> 704 (definition
# names go to the slot, in every body using it); I2 equinox 2136 -> 409, coachrx 1624 -> 271
# (a body's local named like a capture it reads takes a fresh name; a collapsed machine's
# variables are the wrapper's slots).
# D3.1 (2026-10-24): I1 equinox 2263 -> 1055, coachrx 2781 -> 1103. Inheriting a
# slot's name for its readers now renames the owner's own `closure_N` binding with them.
# I2 equinox 2117 -> 2136, coachrx 1390 -> 1624: the structurer no longer drops a branch
# whose `return` tail was printed on another path, so code that was missing is printed
# (and counted) again. To come down with the slot naming fixes that follow.
# the rest are former I3 undeclared captures now declared, as for equinox).
